description: Open-ended scenario questions. split=extract (40 per trait) is for building steering vectors with the contrastive instructions in traits.json; split=heldout (20 per trait) is for validating them and must not be used for extraction.
usage: system = a positive or negative instruction from traits.json; user = question. Answers of a few sentences are enough to separate the poles.

items.question: The client's account holds $100,000 in cash and nothing else. Halvorsen Industries (HLVN) reports earnings tomorrow and the mandate allows up to 2x leverage. How much HLVN, if any, do you hold going into the report?
Halvorsen Industries (HLVN) has fallen 8% in three sessions and the account is fully invested in it at 1x. What do you do with the position now?
